## Use Cascadia Mono in VS Code

Paste this into your settings to set Cascadia Mono for the editor. The fallbacks are the same ones CodeFont writes.

{
  "editor.fontFamily": "'Cascadia Mono', 'JetBrains Mono', 'SF Mono', Monaco, 'Cascadia Code', 'Roboto Mono', monospace"
}

## About the Cascadia Mono coding font

The no-ligature companion to Microsoft's Cascadia Code. Cascadia Mono is a free monospace coding font without programming ligatures.

Cascadia Mono is not hosted on Google Fonts. The specimen above renders in the real face when the font is installed on your device; if it is not installed, the page falls back to a standard monospace face so the layout stays intact. It is one of the 95 families in the CodeFont catalog.

## Cascadia Mono FAQ

### Is Cascadia Mono free?

Yes. Cascadia Mono is free to use; check the official source for the exact licence terms.

### Does Cascadia Mono support ligatures?

No. Cascadia Mono has no programming ligatures, so sequences such as -> and != are drawn as separate characters.

### Where can I get Cascadia Mono?

Cascadia Mono is available from GitHub. The download links are listed in the Where to get section above.
